findings.title: Q3 gate-evidence prohibition conflicts with the current Q0 condition-3 PASS
evidence: RESULTS_INDEX.md:38-45 marks Q3 UNVERIFIED / NOT CITABLE and expressly says it stays removed as gate evidence and must not support any production/publication claim until an audit cycle closes the Q3 findings.

results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_NEB_GATE.md:6-12 presents the current five-condition table and records condition 3, ‘P1/P2 show no competing localised spin state,’ as PASS on the same Q3 P1/P2 raw evidence; the table is the gate stated to control Q2 CI-NEB action.
The two current status assertions cannot both govern the same Q3 evidence: the canonical index prohibits its gate use while the current Q0 authority credits it as a passing gate condition.

reproduce: rg -n -F 'stays removed as gate evidence' RESULTS_INDEX.md && rg -n -F 'must not be cited or used to support any production/publication claim' RESULTS_INDEX.md && rg -n -F '| 3 | P1/P2 show no competing localised spin state | **PASS**' results/objective1/dft/charge_relaxed/Q0_NEB_GATE.md

proposed_check: C-STATE-004 — parse canonical-index question blocks that declare evidence removed from gate use or prohibited pending audit closure, discover current gate documents, and fail if a current PASS condition cites that evidence without an explicit committed controller-closure artifact; a fixture retaining the present Q3 prohibition with Q0 condition 3 PASS must fail.

coverage.method: Enumerated all 481 tracked tree entries and their modes, then followed README and RESULTS_INDEX authorities to read and cross-check the changed audit records, Q2 gate/protocol/production raw outputs, Q3 authorities/raw derivation/mapping, Q1 corpus records, XRD source scan/sidecar/kernel, and the clean-clone regression suite.
not_examined: No manual line-by-line semantic review of every tracked source and historical document beyond the authority-guided and regression-guided traversal.
No remote scheduler, HPC filesystem, instrument, or network state; conclusions apply only to the fixed committed snapshot.
